document.description: US Green Card: verified visitor visa exemptions for Belize, the Dominican Republic, Georgia, Mexico and Serbia. This is a partial destination list, separate from US visa privileges.

unlocks.conditions: Hold a valid US Permanent Residence Card. The Belize entry-visa exemption covers visits of no more than 30 days.

source.pageSection: Belize Immigration > Visa > Do You Need a Visa to Visit Belize > exemption list, United States bullet
source.verificationPath: Belize Immigration > Visa > Do You Need a Visa to Visit Belize > exemption list, United States bullet
source.exactQuote: Permanent Residence Card from the United States of America

unlocks.notes: This records the permanent-residence-card exemption separately from US visa holders. Stays beyond 30 days require the applicable Immigration Office extension.

unlocks.conditions: Hold valid permanent residence in the United States and a valid passport. Entry without a Dominican visa is for tourism using a Tourist Card.

source.pageSection: MIREX > Portal Unico de Servicios > Visas > Decreto Num. 691-07
source.verificationPath: MIREX > Portal Unico de Servicios > Visas > Decreto Num. 691-07

unlocks.notes: Tourist Card access is limited to tourism and does not authorize work, study or residence. DGII describes a 30-day initial stay, with extensions treated separately. The Tourist Card is an entry tax and is generally included in air tickets issued abroad.

staySource.pageSection: DGII > Tarjeta de Turista > Sobre Tarjeta de Turista
staySource.verificationPath: DGII > Tarjeta de Turista > Sobre Tarjeta de Turista

unlocks.conditions: Hold a US permanent resident card valid on the day of entry into Georgia and present the travel and/or other appropriate document proving its validity. Visa-free stays are limited to 90 calendar days in any 180-day period.

source.pageSection: Georgian MFA legal-act PDF > Ordinance No. 256 > annex item 3 (United States), entry conditions 1-2; 2025 amendment in condition 3
source.verificationPath: Georgian MFA legal-act PDF > Ordinance No. 256 > annex item 3 (United States), entry conditions 1-2; 2025 amendment in condition 3

unlocks.notes: The source is the Georgian text incorporating Ordinance No. 122 of 17 April 2025. Its extra one-year validity condition concerns specified Gulf-issued documents, not US residence permits. This is a rolling 90/180 allowance, not 90 days per entry.

unlocks.conditions: Present a valid passport and proof of permanent residence in the United States for a tourist/visitor stay without paid activities.

source.pageSection: Embassy of Mexico in Australia > Visitor visa for Mexico PDF > page 1, General Information and Do I need a Visitor Visa?
source.verificationPath: Embassy of Mexico in Australia > Visitor visa for Mexico PDF > page 1, General Information and Do I need a Visitor Visa?
source.exactQuote: you do not need a visitor visa

unlocks.notes: 180 days is an upper limit, not an automatic grant: immigration officers determine the admitted period from the intended activities and supporting documents. The permanent-residence exemption is separate from the US visa exemption; it does not authorize paid work or residence.

unlocks.conditions: Hold a valid US residence permit and a valid national passport. Emergency travel documents and documents issued under international conventions are excluded. Stay up to 90 days during a six-month period, within the residence permit's validity.

source.pageSection: Serbian MFA > Citizens > Travel to Serbia > Visa Requirements > opening decision and residence-card paragraphs
source.verificationPath: Serbian MFA > Citizens > Travel to Serbia > Visa Requirements > opening decision and residence-card paragraphs
source.exactQuote: residence permit in the countries of the Schengen area, EU or the United States of America

unlocks.notes: A residence card must be presented together with a valid passport. The six-month aggregate limit is not a fresh 90 days per entry. This entry records US permanent residence separately from US visas.
